---
title: "Give a second look to hand checks"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-06 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Look over shots that a groomer checked by hand against a photo of the
paperwork, so the shop has a manager's second look on record.

## Applies to

Managers only.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).

## Procedure

1. On the Admin overview, click **Checked by hand, to look over**. The list
   opens, one line per shot, with the dog, the dates the groomer typed and
   the groomer's name.
2. Click **see the photo ↗** under the shot. The photo of the paperwork
   opens in a new tab. Compare its dates with the dates listed, then return to
   the Admin tab.
3. Click one:
   - **Matches the photo:** the dates are right. The shot leaves the list.
   - **Doesn't match: fix it:** the dates are wrong. Go to step 4.
4. Enter the dates as the photo shows them in **Given** and **Expires**.
   Your dates replace the groomer's. The groomer's name stays on the record,
   and what they typed is kept in the history.
5. Click **Save the right dates**.

## Result

The shot leaves the **Checked by hand, to look over** list. On the dog's
card, the shot shows **manager agreed**, or **dates fixed by** your name.
